reviewMethod: Original 119-frame review retained for byte-identical exterior assets. After export-only interior batching, all 83 interior-containing actual-GLB frames were rerendered and visually reviewed through the refreshed overview, boarding, lighting, interior LOD, all entry and all seat contact sheets.

findings.wholeObjectFraming: pass; front/rear/top cameras widened after initial cropping was found
findings.hollowCabinAndDoors: pass; open doorway visibly exposes continuous interior floor and independent sliding leaves
findings.leadMiddleTailIdentity: pass; outer end observation windows and inner/middle gangway openings differ
findings.lodShapeAndDatum: pass; all LODs fit the full frame and preserve width/height/contact datum; coarse LOD is explicitly closed and nonboardable
findings.seatsAndEntries: pass; all 36 seat-camera and 18 entry views show cabin space; priority seats and clear zones are distinct
findings.interiorLodPair: pass; same aisle camera, ceiling/floor/major passage retained
findings.scaleReference: pass; 1m ruler and procedural 1.75m/1.81m figures, on QA platform at floor/sill Y=.95
findings.materialRoles: pass; steel-metal wheel/bogie/coupler primitives separately CPU-verified; rubber restricted to bellows
findings.fourLightingConditions: pass; clear/overcast/dusk/night distinguish surfaces; no claim of city renderer parity
findings.staticInteriorBatching: pass; six material primitives at each interior LOD, geometry and framing visually preserved. Exact component binary comparison maximum attribute error 4.76837158203125e-07; editable sources/exterior exports unchanged.

repairsCompleted: Window mullions moved entirely inside wall spans after actual door-leaf sweep collision revealed 45mm intrusion.
Overhead rail raised to preserve at least 2.05m passenger clearance.
Front/rear/top orthographic framing expanded to include complete bounds.
QA humanoid construction corrected to actual full reference heights.
Wheel/bogie/coupler placeholder rubber replaced by steel-metal with actual primitive validation.
knownLimitations: Visible Monte Carlo noise at requested 8 samples; this Blender build lacks OpenImageDenoise.
Low-poly representative research geometry, not an exact manufactured SkyTrain model.
LOD1 simplifies livery detail and LOD2 loses openings by declared design.
No runtime transparent sorting, animation timing, dynamic collision or moving inter-car traversal acceptance.
